title: FACESEC: A Fine-grained Robustness Evaluation Framework for Face Recognition Systems
reasoning: The paper presents a technical framework for evaluating the adversarial robustness of face recognition systems. While the motivation for this work touches upon security and potential misuse (e.g., bypassing biometric verification), the framework itself does not evaluate or benchmark morals, ethics, or faith. The evaluation criteria are purely technical, such as attack success rate.
